task_results.message: Cloud Run servisinin plaintext BEACHGO_DB_CONN env var ile calistigi, appuser kullanicisinin Cloud SQL uzerinde aktif oldugu ve secret-backed gecise uygun oldugu dogrulandi.

task_results.title: Rotate Cloud SQL app password
task_results.message: Cloud SQL instance beachgo-db icindeki appuser parolasi yeni rastgele 32 karakterlik parola ile rotate edildi.

task_results.title: Move connection string into Secret Manager
task_results.message: Secret Manager secret BEACHGO_DB_CONN olusturuldu ve version 1 icine yeni Cloud SQL connection string yazildi.

task_results.title: Update Cloud Run to secret-backed DB config

task_results.message: Gemini kalan risk olarak eski revision cleanup, CI/CD secret parity, least-privilege IAM ve rotation automation notlarini isaret etti.
